testcase.name: the seeded machines are flagged, and nothing else is
help is never counted as volume, and has no estimated max
the hardest set of a session is the one with least help
labels say help, so a number is never read the wrong way round
below the top the help stays and one more rep is the target
a stall suggests more help, not a lighter plate
a record is less help for as many reps
at the top of the range the help comes down, not up
help never goes below zero, and zero is the lift itself
milestones count down to the unassisted lift
a lift is recognised by its name whatever the case
